resolved_findings.finding: A free-text search request could bypass the DecisionSurface Cell/Slot contract and reintroduce evidence-dump behavior.
resolved_findings.repair: The compiler input contains only exact Contract/Cell/Slot objects and bounded typed overrides; no free-query field exists.

resolved_findings.finding: The existing M2 acceptance_role labels primary/bounded_context are not the same vocabulary as TECH_02 fact/numeric_fact/context/gap_evidence roles.
resolved_findings.repair: A versioned M6.1 role policy maps the two independently and rejects unapproved source-policy or acceptance-role combinations.

resolved_findings.finding: An exact numeric request without row/unit/period/source-coordinate requirements could later be promoted from an ambiguous table value.
resolved_findings.repair: Issuer metric requests always carry numeric and metadata binding requirements; M6.1 only declares them and leaves parsing/promotion to M6.5/M6.6.

resolved_findings.finding: Route and budget fields could be mistaken for Tool Registry execution admission.
resolved_findings.repair: The request records declarative constraints only; M6.2 is still unimplemented and M6.1 has no tool, provider, network, store-write or admission API.

open_followups: M6.2 must independently implement and review ToolRegistrySnapshot, capability admission and bounded planner state before any route can execute.
M6.3-M6.6 remain responsible for candidate retrieval, parsing, numeric trace and evidence promotion; no M6.1 request is evidence itself.
No paid model, provider, external tool/network, Evidence/Writer runtime, full-chain, business Case mutation or legacy authority change is admitted.
